assessment: The radiation function is version 2 and behaves as version 1 when the dose factor is one. The power function was re-verified against the new degradation point and the replaced worked case, with no code change. With deployable panels as the baseline, every requirement is met, including 6 dB of link margin.
emergent_effects: The larger array raised dry mass through X-3 and mass headroom is still positive.
The dose factor lowers the radiation margin to just above 2. More life or less shielding will fail it.
lessons: When evidence changes and the method does not, re-verify the function. Do not rebuild it.
